protocol.meaning: Author-declared air+large-paper-baffle condition3. These six originals were absent from this worker retained acquisition/source scan before freeze. Reuse unchanged small-baffle method and all alternatives, but derive every coefficient only from these original condition3 training courses. No condition2 damping reused. Delta remains empirical, not physical length correction. All three receiving repetitions are selected now, no replacement or outcome tuning.
protocol.selection: Original5–25s rows and supplied rate, no smoothing, resampling or recentering. Prefix5–6s estimates starts only, suffix6–25s scores.
protocol.primary: Mean prefix-suffix RMSE across all three predeclared length5 repetitions, selected-offset versus pooled-zero; all individual outcomes and observed-start/single-inverse alternatives retained, refusals never dropped.
protocol.qualification: New condition qualification; past air-only and small-baffle courses remain consumed. Shared angular damping is an explicit conditional hypothesis, not established by condition label.

metrics.meaning: No training metrics on transferred coefficients

transfer.basis: Conditional unchanged angular damping from original condition3 length3 training only; no prior-condition damping reused.
transfer.meaning: Same compact weak operator on original training positions, shared empirical −A/(L+delta) sine coefficient, independent course damping. Supplied starts/rates never fit this relation. Window residual is not forward prediction error, physical geometry calibration or identification. Every offered relation retained; no receiving input.

source.label: len5_cond3_1.csv
source.conditionBasis: Author-declared condition3 air+large paper baffle; identity association is conditional, not proof of equal damping across setups.
source.transform: Original declared columns/time rows; no smoothing, resampling, recentering or unit conversion

rateObservation.basis: Original PASCO supplied angular rate; not independent from angle

resolution.meaning: Difference between free-running predictions at two step resolutions; not a calibrated error bound or evidence of physical validity.
limitations: Agreement between two resolutions can miss shared numerical bias or unresolved dynamics.
Discontinuous Coulomb sign changes can invalidate smooth-law RK4 convergence assumptions.
Stiff dynamics can remain inaccurate or unstable at both resolutions.
The comparison does not alter the model, observations, initial conditions, or training ranking.
